LanguageData.VRE_GeneInfector.description: Carriers of this gene implant a copy of their xenogerm into another person through attacks with their claws or teeth. This in turn triggers a progressing infection in the victim, which if left untreated will apply the carrier’s xenogerm to them.
LanguageData.VRE_GeneInfector.label: gene infector
LanguageData.VRE_MindCoalescence.description: Carriers of this gene have a psychic connection to other carriers, allowing them to share some of the emotions with them. A portion of average happiness gets shared with mind coalescent individuals. Due to that, they also all share mental states and suffer them at the same time.
LanguageData.VRE_MindCoalescence.label: mind coalescence
